A man turning one hundred asked for one hundred birthday cards.
Joe was living in a care home in Texas.
When a caregiver asked what he wanted, he said: nothing really. Just happiness.
So she took his photo with a sign: I would like to receive one hundred birthday cards.
Within days: two thousand five hundred cards.
Then sixteen thousand. From Japan. Germany. Australia. Guam.
Someone paid three hundred dollars to express-mail one card from Hong Kong.
The home had to open an empty room just for the mail.
On his birthday: fifty thousand cards.
Did he get his hundred? "I bet I have."
He asked for so little. Just to be thought of.
Not everyone has fifty thousand strangers writing back.
